_comment: FACTORtv — RACE FLOW dialogue: the categories that carry a race across
its length rather than reacting to a single event.
Ported as OBSERVATIONS from RacerTV's commentary_lines.json, which was
built by watching races and noting what the booth had nothing to say
about. The text is re-voiced: Miles Crawford calls and reports, Chuck
Brannigan reads the race, and Chuck's first-person claims are stock-car
claims because that is the career he actually had.
Extra slots used here: {dist} race distance text, {mark} distance
milestone, {mins} minutes remaining, {n} a count, {from_pos} a place a
driver has come from, {pos} their place now.
